title: job event: progress
description: Progress of a running job. phase transfer: one per received data frame, done/total in bytes. phase flash/edl/tool: one per output line of the tool, done = total = 0 (clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:3587, 3615, 3661, 1903, 2451). total = 0 means indeterminate. JobPhase on the hub lists only transfer and flash (known-gaps G5).
